claims.disproof_condition: 條件：B&W 之後的 10-Q／8-K 寫出 Base Electron 合約終止、縮減座數、延後商轉超過一年，或北達科他的 Conditional Use Permit 被拒；核查頻率：每季（B&W 10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀鍋爐＋汽輪機這條路線。
claims.statement: B&W 10-Q (Q2 2026): definitive agreement with Base Electron (2026-02-26) to design and install four 300 MW natural gas-fired power plants of boilers and steam turbines for an AI factory; total consideration USD 2.4 billion, of which USD 2.0 billion is variable (reimbursable costs plus mark-up) and the rest a fixed fee; commercial operation targeted 2030; USD 100.7 million recognized in Q2 and 131.7 million year-to-date. Already in reported revenue. Most of the value is cost pass-through, so the contract size overstates B&W's margin pool.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Applied Digital 或 B&W 之後的申報寫出 Base Electron 案取消、Applied Digital 退出支持，或改由電網供電。核查頻率：每季（B&W 10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence。
claims.statement: Applied Digital signed the November 2025 limited notice to proceed with B&W for the four 300 MW gas-fired boiler and steam turbine plants to power an AI factory; the definitive agreement was then signed by Base Electron.

sources.locator: 附註 Applied Digital/Base Electron Agreements
sources.quote: In November 2025, we entered into a limited notice to proceed ("LNTP") with Applied Digital for a project to design and install four 300 -megawatt natural gas-fired power plants consisting of boilers and associated steam turbines to deliver power for an AI factory.

sources.locator: 附註 Revenue Recognition—Base Electron Agreement
sources.quote: Effective February 26, 2026, we entered into a written definitive agreement with Base Electron, to complete the design and installation of four 300 -megawatt natural gas-fired power plants.

sources.locator: 附註 Revenue Recognition—Base Electron Agreement
sources.quote: The total consideration in exchange for completion of this project is $ 2.4 billion, of which $ 2.0 billion is for variable charges and the remaining is a fixed fee.

sources.locator: 附註 Revenue Recognition—Base Electron Agreement
sources.quote: The variable charges are based on reimbursable costs incurred plus mark-up.

sources.locator: 附註 Revenue Recognition—Base Electron Agreement
sources.quote: The plant is targeted to begin commercial operation in 2030.

sources.locator: 附註 Revenue Recognition—Base Electron Agreement
sources.quote: For the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, we have recognized $ 100.7 million and $ 131.7 million of revenue related to this contract, respectively.
